selection.reason: 국의 온도 차이; 동일 core 조건은 불가하여 menu 범위를 사전에 지정
국적 이외의 미세한 맛 차이; 벡터 방향 진단상 어려운 대조를 사전에 포함

limitations: Frozen-catalogue real vectors with hypothetical feedback; not online user accuracy or a measurement after the later live-data refresh.
Six seeds reuse catalogue stores and are not independent users.
Zero card balance change does not imply identical stores or identical ranking.
Selection examples frozen before model results; alignment diagnostic had already been inspected.
Core and menu label populations must be kept separate.
Attribute labels describe evidence across a store menu, not necessarily the same dish used as the current-food context.
Operational partial leave-one-out scoring and research full-posterior scoring use observed responses differently; final-card retention is not a fair model-superiority estimate.
